title: The coffee bar till
hints: Start with the types. A literal union lists the allowed strings joined with `|`, and an object type lists each property with its type between `{ }`.

`type Size = "small" | "medium" | "large";` then `type CoffeeOrder = { drink: string; size: Size; shots: number; oatMilk: boolean };`. For the price, pick the base with an if/else chain on `order.size`, then add `(order.shots - 1) * 6` and 5 if `order.oatMilk`.
withOatMilk must build a brand-new object instead of assigning to the old one: `return { drink: order.drink, size: order.size, shots: order.shots, oatMilk: true };`
